name: Policy Forge
short_description: An offline cloud-security configuration review desk: Bash and PowerShell adapters, OPA/Rego findings cited to the exact source line, expiring exceptions, and remediation patches verified before they are offered.
capabilities: Bash + jq adapter for AWS-CLI-shaped exports and PowerShell 7 adapter for Azure-PowerShell-shaped exports, one normalized inventory
Exact source file and line for every cited value; redacted excerpts; sensitive fields never published
13 Rego rules for public storage, broad IAM, unrestricted ingress, missing audit settings and risky relationships, each with positive, negative and boundary fixtures
Unevaluable semantics and unsupported resource types reported as unknown, never as passed
Narrowly scoped, expiring exceptions validated with Conftest
Local-file remediation patches re-verified by re-running the whole review; one git-appliable bundle
GitHub-native run ledger, outcome loop and memory curation; no cloud credentials anywhere
data_limitations: All snapshots are synthetic exports of a fictional organisation
A deliberately bounded rule set; each rule lists what it does not evaluate
Patches edit captured JSON only; nothing is applied to any cloud account
The site shows a snapshot of the state branch, not live data
